verdict.rationale:
The SDK provides the core building blocks for autonomous multi-step agent loops (Runner.run/run_sync/run_streamed, handoffs, guardrails, tool calls, human-in-the-loop pausing) that execute without step-by-step human intervention, and sandbox agents can run isolated tasks. However there is no evidence of scheduling, triggers, cron-like jobs, or a hosted mechanism to keep automations running unattended in the background independent of a client process invoking Runner.run.

missing for 10: scheduling/trigger primitives, persistent/hosted background execution infrastructure, evidence of long-running unattended automation deployment.
